A little more you.

This profile appears on every estimate.

Changes update this device’s profile. Already saved quotes keep a snapshot of the profile used when they were saved.

Your records. In your hands.

CleanQuote stores your business profile, draft, and saved jobs in this browser. They do not sync to other devices. Clearing browser data can remove them.

Restore validates the file and asks before replacing this device’s records. Keep backup files private; they contain customer details.

A good first quote.

  1. Add your business profile.
  2. Describe the job, scope, and exclusions.
  3. Enter total cleaner-hours and your own costs.
  4. Review the customer document and save the quote.
  5. Print / save a PDF, then send it yourself.
  6. Record actual costs and export a backup.

Use the browser print dialog’s “Save as PDF.” Turn off browser headers and footers for a cleaner document.

Know what the numbers mean.

Labor compensation pays the cleaner for their time. Business profit is what remains after that pay, job costs, and entered fees. Tax collected is separate.

A discount lowers the planned margin. All results depend on your inputs and are estimates. Check applicable taxes and your own terms.

Built to stay focused.

CleanQuote prepares estimates and message copy. You send the messages yourself. It does not schedule work, process your customers’ payments, or provide accounting.

This is a working preview with fictional starting details. Purchases are not enabled.
